parameters.name: BeforeWorkloadId
parameters.description: Retrieves workloads that precede the specified workload ID in the queue.

parameters.name: GmtDequeuedTimeRange
parameters.description: Filters workloads by their dequeue time range.

parameters.name: GmtEnqueuedTimeRange
parameters.description: Filters workloads by their enqueue time range.

parameters.name: GmtPositionModifiedTimeRange
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the time range of their last queue position change.

parameters.name: NodeName
parameters.description: Filters workloads by node name.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order for the results. Valid values are `asc` for ascending and `desc` for descending.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page.

parameters.name: QuotaId
parameters.description: The ID of the quota.

parameters.name: ShowOwn
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only workloads that belong to the specified quota.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field to use for sorting the results.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filters workloads by their status in the queue.

parameters.name: SubQuotaIds
parameters.description: Filters workloads by sub-quota ID. You can specify multiple IDs, separated by commas.

parameters.name: UserIds
parameters.description: Filters workloads by user ID. You can specify multiple IDs, separated by commas.

parameters.name: WithHistoricalData
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include historical data in the query results.

parameters.name: WorkloadCreatedTimeRange
parameters.description: Filters workloads based on their creation time range.

parameters.name: WorkloadIds
parameters.description: Filters workloads by workload ID. You can specify multiple IDs, separated by commas.

parameters.name: WorkloadStatuses
parameters.description: Filters workloads by status. You can specify multiple statuses, separated by commas.

parameters.name: WorkloadType
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the sub-product type of the instance.

parameters.name: WorkspaceIds
parameters.description: Filters workloads by workspace ID. You can specify multiple IDs, separated by commas.
